#summary The Mecab-using versions (0.9.2+) crash on some Windows PCs
#labels Phase-Support

= Error symptons =

After installing a 0.9.2 or higher version of Furigana Injector, Firefox crashes as soon as it starts.

The error will be a runtime error such as: ...


= Immediate Fix =

Start Firefox in safe mode, and uninstall Furigana Injector ("Tools" menu -> "Add-ons" dialog).


= Further Debugging =

Install the ordinary Mecab package.

= Stick with the old version =

A relabeled old version, "Furigana Injector (No Mecab)" is available. Install this instead of the regular Furigana Injector.
